teaser.en: Its leaves are woven into the mats called *ukuti wa uchindu*, and its little orange dates are a riverside snack.
teaser.sw: Majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka inayoitwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tende zake ndogo za rangi ya machungwa ni kitafunio cha kando ya mto.
teaser.dg: Makodzage nkusukwa majamvi ganagoihwa *ukuti wa uchindu*, na tendeze ndide za rangi ya chungbwa ni chakurya cha kanda-kanda ya miho.

summary.en: *Uchindu*, the wild date palm, is a clumping palm of riverbanks, wet valleys and forest edges, with small orange dates. Its leaves are woven into mats and baskets, so heavily in places that the palm is over-exploited.
summary.sw: *Uchindu* ni mkindu, mchikichi unaoota kwa vichaka wa kingo za mito, mabonde yenye unyevu na pembezoni mwa misitu, wenye tende ndogo za rangi ya machungwa. Majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu, kwa wingi kiasi kwamba katika baadhi ya maeneo mchikichi huu unatumiwa kupita kiasi.
summary.dg: *Uchindu* ni muhi wa jamii ya mnazi unaomera kpwa vitsaka kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye tende ndide za rangi ya chungbwa. Makodzage nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu, na kpwa phatu phanjina kpwa unji hata muhi unahumirwa kutsupa chiasi.

about.en:
*Uchindu* grows in clumps of slender, often leaning trunks up to 15 metres tall. Its arching feather leaves carry sharp spines near their base, so the clumps are hard to push through.

The fruits are small dates, orange-brown when ripe, hanging in bunches from the female trees.
about.sw:
*Uchindu* huota kwa vichaka vya mashina membamba, ambayo mara nyingi huinama, yenye urefu wa hadi mita 15. Majani yake yaliyopinda kama manyoya yana miiba mikali karibu na kitako chake, kwa hivyo ni vigumu kupenya katikati ya vichaka hivyo.

Matunda ni tende ndogo, za rangi ya kahawia-machungwa zikiiva, zinazoning'inia kwa vishada kutoka miti ya kike.
about.dg:
*Uchindu* unamera kpwa makundi ga makolo membamba, ambago kpwa kawaida ganabeduka, ga urefu wa hadi mita 15. Makodzage ga manyoya ganagootyoka gana miya ya ntsa phephi na kolo, kpwa hivyo ni vigumu kuinjira kahi ya makundi gaga.

Matunda ni tende ndide, za rangi ya chungbwa na dongo zichiivwa, zinazobwadzika kpwa mabunda kula kpwa mihi ya chichetu.

where.en: It grows on riverbanks, in wet valleys and at forest edges, along stream banks and wet places in the coastal belt. Clumps of leaning trunks by water are a good sign of it.
where.sw: Hustawi kwenye kingo za mito, katika mabonde yenye unyevu na pembezoni mwa misitu, kando ya vijito na mahali penye unyevu katika ukanda wa pwani. Vichaka vya mashina yanayoinama kando ya maji ni ishara nzuri kwamba upo.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho, kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, kanda-kanda ya miho midide na phatu pha madzi-madzi kpwa uphande wa pwani. Makundi ga makolo ganagobeduka phephi na madzi ni ishara nono kukala uchindu uphapho.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit is eaten, and the palm is tapped for palm wine.

The leaves are woven into mats and baskets; Pakia records the phrase *ukuti wa uchindu*, the *uchindu* frond. They are also used for thatch and for beds. The plant is used in fire-making and has ceremonial uses.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva huliwa, na mchikichi huu hugemwa ili kupata tembo.

Majani husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu; Pakia anarekodi msemo *ukuti wa uchindu*, jani la *uchindu*. Pia hutumika kuezekea na kutengenezea vitanda. Mmea huu hutumika katika kuwasha moto na una matumizi ya kitamaduni ya sherehe.
uses.dg:
Tunda ririroivwa nkuriwa, na muhi nkujemwa kpwa uchi.

Makodza nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu; Pakia anaandika maneno *ukuti wa uchindu*, kodza ra *uchindu*. Piya nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba na kuhenda vitanda. Mmea uhu nkuhumirwa kpwa kuasa moho na una kazi za mambo ga chimila.

culture.en: Pakia records that *uchindu* has ceremonial uses, though the details are not described.
culture.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba *uchindu* una matumizi ya kitamaduni ya sherehe, ingawa undani wake haujaelezwa.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *uchindu* nkuhumirwa kpwa mambo ga chimila, ela kaeleza mambo higo kpwa urefu.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *uchindu*; the ICRAF handbook and Maundu and Tengnäs give *mchindu* and *makindu*. In Swahili it is *mkindu*. In Giriama it is *mkindu* or *mkindwi*, and the fruit is *kindwi*. In English it is the wild date palm, and its scientific name is *Phoenix reclinata*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *uchindu*; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF na Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mchindu* na *makindu*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkindu*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mkindu* au *mkindwi*, na tunda ni *kindwi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *wild date palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Phoenix reclinata*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *uchindu*; chitabu cha ICRAF na Maundu na Tengnäs anapha *mchindu* na *makindu*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkindu*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mkindu* au *mkindwi*, na tunda ni *kindwi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *wild date palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Phoenix reclinata*.

conservation.en: It is over-exploited in places for handicrafts.
conservation.sw: Katika baadhi ya maeneo unatumiwa kupita kiasi kwa kazi za mikono.
conservation.dg: Kpwa phatu phanjina unahumirwa kutsupa chiasi kpwa kazi za mikpwono.

reason.en: Same genus: the cultivated date palm
Another palm whose leaves are woven into mats
reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine ambao majani yake husukwa kuwa mikeka
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi ambao makodzage nkusukwa majamvi

reason.en: Another palm of wet places used for weaving
reason.sw: Mchikichi mwingine wa mahali penye unyevu unaotumika kusuka
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa jamii ya mnazi wa phatu pha madzi-madzi unaohumirwa kusukira

reason.en: Shares wet valleys and stream banks
reason.sw: Hushiriki mabonde yenye unyevu na kingo za vijito
reason.dg: Unamera phamwenga kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kanda-kanda ya miho midide

definition.en: The midrib of a wild date palm leaflet. Coconut part names are only occasionally used for other palms, and then with 'of uchindu' added.
definition.sw: Ubavu wa kijani cha jani la mkindu. Majina ya sehemu za mnazi hutumika kwa michikichi mingine mara chache tu, na hapo huongezewa 'wa uchindu'.
definition.dg: Mongo wa kodza dide ra uchindu. Madzina ga seemu za mnazi nkuhumirwa mara chache bahi kpwa mihi yanjina ya jamii ya minazi, na phapho nkuenjerezwa 'wa uchindu'.

meaning.en: Ukuti of the wild date palm.
